note: Demo headline. httk has no human hepatic clearance for amlodipine, so the exposure layer uses the minimal compartmental model, not PBPK. Published window: excess loop-diuretic start over the first months (Savage 2020 days 1-90 with risk still rising; Vouri 2019 first 4 months).

httk has no human clearance for gabapentin or pregabalin: no exposure layer. Published: cascade at a median of 36 days (IQR 15-61) after initiation (Hayes 2026); oedema onset median 23 days (IQR 10-54, Largeau 2022).

PBPK layer with httk (haloperidol and risperidone have human parameters). Published timing is qualitative: days to weeks after starting an antipsychotic (Shin 2012); Avorn 1995 measured exposure in the 90 days before antiparkinson therapy.
httk has no human clearance for these ACE inhibitors. Published onset: hours after the first dose to months (Dicpinigaitis 2006); PSSA over a half-year window (Vegter 2010).

PBPK layer with httk (metoclopramide has human parameters). PIPC row 18 is written for antipsychotics; metoclopramide is a dopamine antagonist treated here as the same pattern, which is an interpretive extension and is labelled as such.
